client: Public demo: Microsoft Northwind 2.0 Developer Edition (Access)

source.on_mismatch: report blocked; never update pins without the user
source._checked: Downloaded and hashed 2026-10-16 from a cloud container (HTTP 200). A HEAD request the same day returned the same size, last-modified, etag and content-md5 (hex of g+dJsjno1zYgDogST1w43g==). These header pins let a HEAD request catch drift before the 12.9 MB download.
source._saved_with_data: The template ships with its sample data, so no data_copy is needed.
source.licence: Microsoft publishes no licence. Never commit or redistribute the file, its data or its VBA. Only mp-data fetch downloads it, into the private directory.

target.visibility: private until the S6 gate, then public
target._visibility: Integrate and checkpoint run mp-data guard with --history in every demo stage, before they push, so a leak anywhere in the history is caught before the flip. Once the repo is public, you run it before every push of your own too.

_records: null: records live in <pipeline>/engagements/northwind-demo (the default for demos).
_database: stage1 is null: there is no client cutover. S3 loads the engagement dataset only into the local Docker databases mpdata_northwind_demo_stage1 (PostgreSQL and SQL Server), and relink-scan prints 'not set (demo)' for the cutover facts.
_hosting: No deployment; the public repo is the deliverable.

data_policy._execution: Public sample data, so cloud sessions are allowed. The client data plane still applies, as a rehearsal: data zone, mp-data, redaction, scrub and mpdata_ databases. From S1 on the driver runs every other command through mp-run, which hides the data zone, so a task that only works by reading it fails here too.
data_policy._consent: Not needed for public sample data. The driver checks ai_terms and client_consent only when bootstrap is false.
data_policy._retention: No retention clock: the private directory holds only public sample data, and the stage prepare lists rebuild it from the pinned source.

secrets._rule: Demo: no secrets. The operator's own git and gh login pushes the pipeline and demo repos. From S1 on those pushes run inside mp-run, which hides the keyring, so the login must be gh's file-stored token over HTTPS (gh auth login --insecure-storage choosing HTTPS, then gh config set git_protocol https and gh auth setup-git; the gh environment item checks that gh auth status names hosts.yml, that both clones' origins are https://github.com/ URLs and that gh is git's credential helper for github.com). mp-data push and mp-data gh are for client target repos only.

must_keep: the invoice report plus at most 4 other reports chosen at S1
scope._note: S1 decides the areas; ids are snake_case. Sign-in and roles belong to the foundation (S4), not to an area.

commercial._milestones: Only for the payment section of the simulated quote (S1). Demos buy nothing, invoice nothing and have no purchased list; the driver checks offers only when bootstrap is false.

environment._windows_box: No Windows + Access machine yet. The S3 gate logs 'relink not rehearsed' unless one becomes available.

expected_inventory._vba_line_rule: Non-blank lines, excluding Attribute lines, in the 18 modules plus the CodeBehindForm/CodeBehindReport sections of forms and reports.
expected_inventory._count_rules: data_macro_files counts only the .axl files under template/database/objects/dataMacros/ (20). The 55 .axl files under template/database/objects/properties/ are object metadata and are not counted (75 .axl files in all).
expected_inventory._measured: 2026-10-16 by a throwaway script over the downloaded file. S0 must reproduce these exactly. A difference fails inventory --expect and is settled with the user: either the parser is fixed (rerun S0.parse and S0.healthcheck with since naming the counting rule), or, after the user re-checks the measurement against _count_rules and _vba_line_rule, a number is corrected here with a dated note. Never edit a number to make a run pass.
